HOME OFFICE (ALIENS DEPARTMENT)
P.O. BOX No. 2,
BOURNEMOUTH,
HANTS.

Karl "GROEHL"
born 2.6.98 at Inoworatzlaw.

With reference to your minute dated 11.10.41 (M.I.5 London Region) in our file G.10661, signed by Mr. G.H. Langdon for Lt. Col. Hinchley Cooke, we are sending to you herewith as requested the original letter with two copies which Werner Zacharias of 4537, Hector Avenue, Cincinnati, Ohio, asked the B.B.C. to forward to Karl Groebl. It is regretted we did not make it clear that the letter was in the large envelope at the back of our file when we sent the file to you.

L. A. Colmore

16th October, 1941.
